//: Copy to ~/.config/logs-axi/config.json (or point LOGS_AXI_CONFIG at it). No secrets here: SigNoz keys come from `logs-axi signoz login` (or LOGS_AXI_SIGNOZ_KEY).

dev.//: ECS services log to /point360/<env> with stream prefix <service>/ (infra/aws/modules/environment/cluster.tf). Add "/point360/dev/api-gateway" for access logs.

SigNoz has no public port: forward it first with `terraform output -raw signoz_ui_command` from infra/aws/environments/dev (local port 3301). The viewer key lives in SSM at /point360/dev/shared/SIGNOZ_VIEWER_KEY; store it with `logs-axi signoz login --env dev`.

prod.//: Same for prod, forwarded to local port 3302 (change localPortNumber in the command) so both can be up at once.
